title: A Good Night's Sleep
paragraphs: Farid usually stays awake very late at night, scrolling through his phone after a long day of work. In the morning, he always feels extremely tired and finds it hard to focus properly during his first meeting.
One night, he finally decides to sleep earlier, right after finishing Isha prayer. He puts his phone in another room and takes a few slow, deep breaths to calm his mind before closing his eyes.

The next morning, Farid wakes up for Fajr prayer feeling truly fresh and clear-headed, something he had almost forgotten was possible on a weekday. His first meeting goes smoothly, and his ideas feel sharper than usual.
After a full week of this new routine, Farid tells his wife that a good night's sleep has quietly changed the quality of his entire workday, far more than any cup of coffee ever could.
